run_seq2seq_training: run a seq2seq model training job using autotrain with a specified project name, data path, and model
register_seq2seq_subcommand: register the seq2seq subparser with argparse including train, deploy, inference, and backend arguments
validate_seq2seq_args: validate that required seq2seq training arguments like project name, data path, and model are specified
create_seq2seq_project: create an autotrain project from seq2seq params and start the training job on the chosen backend
build_seq2seq_cli_command: build a cli command factory that returns a RunAutoTrainSeq2SeqCommand instance from parsed arguments
